sections.title: The Hook: Dynamics in Motion
lecture_lines: We observe change all around us.
Often, we only know how things change.
ODEs help us predict future states.
animations: Create a text 'Dynamics in Motion' in #FFFFFF color in the center.
Fade in a particle system representing changing values #FF00FF alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/planet.svg].
Expand the particles into a complex flow animation #00FFFF and introduce [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pendulum.svg].

sections.title: Core Definition: What is an ODE?
lecture_lines: An ODE relates a function to derivatives.
ODEs are flows of moving systems.
animations: Display equation dy/dx = f(x,y) in #FFFFFF, labeled 'ODE' next to [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/faucet.svg].
Fade out 'ODE' and show x^2 + y^2 = 1 in #FFFF00, labeled 'Static'.
Animate the static equation transforming into a flowing vector field #00FF00 that resembles a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/river.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing the Solution: Slope Fields
lecture_lines: Think of this as directional winds.
Each arrow shows the local trend.
animations: Generate a grid of dots in #FFFFFF.
Transform dots into small directional arrows #00FFFF, labeled 'Wind Field' using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Pulse the arrows to emphasize local trend #FF0000 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/flag.svg].

sections.title: Solving: Finding the Curve
lecture_lines: We connect arrows to find solutions.
Initial conditions fix a specific curve.
They act as anchors for solutions.
animations: Show a single point on the grid #FFFF00, labeled 'Initial Condition', represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/anchor.svg].
Trace a path following the arrows starting from the point #00FF00.
Highlight the final curve in bold #FFFFFF to represent the solution.

sections.title: Summary & Application
lecture_lines: ODEs are the language of nature.
They model behavior over time accurately.
Everything from bridges to heart rates.
animations: Show icons for a bridge [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bridge.svg] and a heart in #00FFFF.
Animate flow lines passing through both icons in #FF0000.
